name: thread-brief
title: Work items
description: Ordinary sessions keep their own work items, like a coordinator: a Work button in the header, the Work panel with a Topic, and what they ask you above the chat box.
author: Ghostex
agentNote: This session keeps its own work items in Ghostex's Work panel (the Work button in the window's header). Once you have a real task, keep them current with the work-items skill: `ghostex work item add`, `now`, `step`, `ask`, `done`, and `ghostex work topic` for the one line at the top of the panel. If `ghostex work` is not a command here (an older Ghostex), skip this.
